snippet.description:
A quick showcase and installation guide for Willybach's HD Graphics mod for Valheim.

You can support the channel at http://patreon.com/LFP and you can buy Steam games DIRECTLY from developers at https://www.nexus.gg/lfpgaming

Step 1 Extract BepInEx to Valheim's main folder: https://thunderstore.io/c/valheim/p/denikson/BepInExPack_Valheim/
Step 2 Install the "Deep North Alpha" files: https://www.nexusmods.com/valheim/mods/2887?tab=files
Step 3 Install the "B" and "A" versions of this mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/valheim/mods/1030?tab=files

#Valheim #mod #mods #indiegame #indie #indiegames #indiedev #indiedeveloper #indiegamedev #modded #gamemod #nexusmods 

0:00 Graphics Comparison
2:35 Installation
9:24 Vanilla vs. Modded

PC Specs: Nvidia RTX 5080 GPU with AMD Ryzen 5 5700X3D CPU and 64GB DDR4 RAM at 3200mhz

Steam description: "A collaborative exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally generated afterlife inspired by Viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage!"
